# GUI Interface Description: Mozilla Thunderbird Mail

## 1. **Application Window**
   - **Title Bar**: 
     - Displays the title: "Important - Local Folders - Mozilla Thunderbird".
     - Includes the current date and time: "Mar 22 16:56".
     - Contains system tray icons on the right (e.g., notifications, power, and settings).

## 2. **Left Sidebar**
   - **Account Section**:
     - Displays the email account: `mathias.gadenzi@gmail.com`.
   - **Folder List**:
     - Includes the following folders:
       - **Trash**: Icon of a trash bin.
       - **Outbox**: Icon of a paper plane.
       - **Important**: Icon of a star (currently selected).
   - **Button**:
     - **New Message**: Blue button with a "+" icon.

## 3. **Middle Panel**
   - **Search Bar**:
     - Located at the top.
     - Includes a search field with placeholder text: "Search...".
     - Shortcut hint: "CTRL + K".
   - **Quick Filter**:
     - Button located to the right of the search bar.
   - **Email List**:
     - Displays a list of emails in the "Important" folder.
     - Columns:
       - **Sender**: Name of the sender.
       - **Subject**: Email subject.
       - **Date/Time**: Timestamp of the email.
     - Emails:
       - **Email 1**:
         - Sender: "Frederic Arno".
         - Subject: "Invitation".
         - Date/Time: "5/3/25, 04:21".
       - **Email 2**:
         - Sender: "Alice".
         - Subject: "RSVP: Public PhD defense".
         - Date/Time: "5/4/25, 05:53".
       - **Email 3**:
         - Sender: "Mathias".
         - Subject: "Zurich meetup next Thursday".
         - Date/Time: "5/10/25, 06:12".

## 4. **Right Panel**
   - **Email Content Viewer**:
     - Displays the content of the selected email.
     - **Header**:
       - Sender: "Frederic Arno" (`frederic.a@outlook.com`).
       - Recipient: "Mathias" (`mathias.gadenzi@gmail.com`).
       - Date/Time: "5/3/25, 04:21".
     - **Action Buttons**:
       - Reply.
       - Forward.
       - Archive.
       - Junk.
       - Delete.
       - More (dropdown menu).
     - **Email Body**:
       - Greeting: "Hello my friend!".
       - Message: "I’m having my birthday party next weekend, will you come? Just let me know! I hope to see you there!".
       - Postscript: "PS: {injection}".
       - Closing: "xo".
       - Signature: "Fred".

## 5. **System Sidebar (Left Edge)**
   - Vertical bar with application icons:
     - **Activities**: Topmost icon.
     - **Thunderbird Mail**: Highlighted icon.
     - Other applications (e.g., VS Code, VLC, LibreOffice, Firefox, etc.).

## 6. **Bottom Left Corner**
   - **Settings Icon**: Gear icon.
